describe: add a button that does something
guide: A button is <button id="..." type="button">Label</button> in index.html, and what it does goes in src/script.js: document.getElementById("...").addEventListener("click", () => { ... }). The id in both places must match exactly.

To show words, put an empty

under it and set its textContent. To change colours, set a CSS variable with document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--bg", colour).
report: There is a "$label" button now. It $what.
The new "$label" button $what. Its code is at the bottom of script.js.
teach: addEventListener("click", ...) tells the page what to do each time the button is pressed.
